label: PF Backlog 403
title: PFSSOT-P10: worker + scheduler API and UI
body:
Doc docs/PF-Backlog-SSOT-Scheduler-Pluggable-Workers-updated.md §26-§28/§39 Phase 10. Expose workers/assignments/scheduler state/backlog/leases/heartbeats/history via existing API conventions; TUI/UI are clients. No second API style.

[decision] P10: build /pf umbrella slash-command surface (thin adapters) FIRST; standalone PF> TUI later; both API clients. /pipeline becomes deprecated alias. worker register is a /pf verb.
